voltage_domain_warnings.description: hvi (75/20) marks sky130's 5V-gate/10.5V-drain thick-oxide voltage domain (see sky130.lvs's ngate_high_voltage/pgate_high_voltage). This curated deck models it for MOS device recognition/model binding (issue #1369: sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5/pfet_g5v0d10v5 under --pdk) and for one DRC rule (nwell.enclosed.hvi.1, nwell.9, issue #3031); no other DRC rule here reads hvi, so every rule still applies its general-case threshold to geometry drawn inside hvi (e.g. diff.width.1 checks difftap.1's 0.15 um where the real DRM's medium-voltage column, difftap.14, requires 0.29 um -- not transcribed in this deck yet).
